notes.title: Crystal Rail Kickstarter Update
notes.content: [p]After 3 and a half years of work and at long last:[/p][h3][b][i][u]Crystal Rail is finally coming to [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/densetsuproductions/crystal-rail-a-rail-rogue-rpg" buttoncolor="#1ba300"]Kickstarter![/url][/u][/i][/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We have strove to create the best game possible, and if you have enjoyed Crystal Rail before, we hope you may consider supporting us in our attempt to bring Crystal Rail's vision to life. [/p][p][/p][p]That said, we have not been idle these last several months; in concert with our new Kickstarter, we have [b][i][u]updated our demo[/u][/i][/b] with the [b][u]single largest update[/u][/b] since we went live on Steam earlier this year.[/p][p][/p][h2]Crystal Rail Kickstarter Demo Update[/h2][list][*][p]Updated User Interface[/p][/*][*][p]Each conductor now has a unique, handpainted, starting station[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317913/2bff3e0b1e1e959a2a99cf77ec8270ec6b362a5d.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]All new Story Mode featuring multiple-endings and animated cutscenes[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317913/f22961d3fdc4be65d6e024419b4a03323012e835.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Greasefish Prologue tells the origins of the Greasefish and introduces new players to the intricacies of train assembly with a new kind of gameplay,[/p][/*][*][p]Greasefish Journey challenges experienced players with a new objective[/p][/*][*][p]Dozens of new events[/p][/*][*][p]100s of new dialogue lines, many featuring Youtuber [url="https://www.youtube.com/@TheOtherFrost"]TheOtherFrost[/url][/p][/*][*][p]New Resource Gain Chance mechanic,[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked Lounge Car and Contraband Car,[/p][/*][*][p]New Haybale Car which can give favors(exclusive to Tarpan),[/p][/*][*][p]Miscellaneous Balance chances and Bugfixes,[/p][/*][*][p]New in-game link to our Kickstarter!![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We have worked ourselves to the bone, as if this were to be the final update to Crystal Rail, but if we are so fortunate as to have your support, we are hopeful this will be only the beginning. If you believe in our vision, please consider supporting us on [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/densetsuproductions/crystal-rail-a-rail-rogue-rpg"]Kickstarter[/url] - we are offering a number of incentives:[/p][list][*][p]Early bird pricing to get the game (limited offer)[/p][/*][*][p]Get your name in the credits[/p][/*][*][p]Name a train company[/p][/*][*][p]Custom drawings[/p][/*][*][p]and more![/p][/*][/list][p]And even if you're not able to support, we greatly appreciate anyone who can spread the word. As many of you know, we are just a couple people who have yearned all our lives to create games, we think we've really got something special here, and we hope to bring it to fruition with your help.[/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely,[/p][p]The CR Team[/p][p][/p][p]PS: For any interested, we've also started a [url="https://www.youtube.com/@CrystalRailGame"]youtube channel[/url] to post trailers and behind-the-scenes work related to the game, we hope you'll enjoy some of the timelapses and other materials we've created along the way to bringing Crystal Rail to life![/p]

notes.title: The Event Update
notes.content:
Greetings conductors! Ever since our demo's debut and showcase in the steam next fest, we have been hard at work on Crystal Rail, and today can show the first fruits of that labor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317913/93a228fce5afb4bcec2b1d527a2e99cc5595e7ae.jpg[/img]

The demo has now been updated to include random Events! Veterans of other roguelites (Slay the Spire and FTL in particular) will be very familiar with random events interspersed with gameplay, offering players a chance at a special reward. Crystal Rail's events have more emphasis on the characters and world, offering you choices which don't just impact your gameplay, but lean into the role-playing aspects of our Rail-Rogue RPG.

Balance is a work in progress, as with everything in Crystal Rail, but we hope that these events will serve as an exciting sneak peak of what's to come. Seeing how excited you are about the hints of character and world lurking in our game's character dialogue and environment art has us thrilled at the prospect of expanding the Crystal Rail world, and we're just getting started.

If you haven't yet tried [url=javascript:ShowGotSteamModal( 'steam://install/3482820', "Crystal Rail Demo", "Download Demo" )]our demo[/url], this is a fantastic time to look into it, and if you played the demo months ago, we hope the new events will peak your interest! As always, we are indebted to your thoughts and feedback, and encourage any interested players to [url=https://discord.gg/EEYwsFjeXd]join our discord[/url] to discuss how we can better improve Crystal Rail.

More improvements are coming, so please stay tuned, and if you like what you see, be sure to tell your friends, and wishlist Crystal Rail! 

-The CR Team
